cost_assumptions.scope: No paid model calls; public GitHub reads have no per-request charge. CPU, network, and hosting costs excluded.

methodology: Both methods replay the same verified issue text, earlier issue, and pinned pytest commit. The keyword-rule baseline searches all hash-verified opening issues in the published case catalog that precede each cutoff, applies lexical match and template rules, and selects type by cue. Controlled responses are a one-pair smoke comparator, not model quality.

run_metadata.expected_outcomes: Human acceptance is recorded in each case; generated replies and semantic citations have not been accepted.
